text:
emma: Kicking off a short thread to lock the console/observability roadmap cuts for next sprint. We need decisions on: dashboards heatmap, tracing hook sampling, cost breakdown per-tenant, and error analytics slices. TL;DR: propose MVP scope and launch gates.

matt: Quick ask — can we make heatmap an opt-in feature for GA? It’s infra-heavy.

aparna: From product POV: customers want per-route cost breakout (high ask from two customers). Heatmap is nice-to-have; cost + error analytics are must-haves.

jin: Technical: heatmap needs pre-aggregations and a new timeseries store. Estimate 4w dev + 2w infra. Per-route cost: 1w to wire up current billing tags + 1w UI.

sana: Customer signal: AcmeHealth and PlateDrop both said they'd need per-route cost in pilot. They'd also want error-sla alerting tied to traces.

emma: Proposed cuts: Must-have = per-route cost (billing tags), error analytics (trace-linking + spike detector), Launch criteria = 3 pilot customers onboarded + dashboard load 95th < 1s. Heatmap = stretch.

matt: Agree. For trace hooks we should support two sampling modes: head-sampling (default 1%) and adaptive (on-error). That reduces telemetry cost.

jin: Implementation notes: add hook in runtime to emit trace id and error flag. Example config snippet:
```
trace_hooks:
  sampling:
    default_rate: 0.01
    on_error_rate: 1.0
```
Need schema review.

aparna: Rollout plan: canary 5% tenants for 2 weeks, monitor cost delta < 10% and false-positive spike rate < 5%. If pass -> gradual 25% -> 100%.

sana: Add "pilot acceptance" to criteria: each pilot must integrate for at least 2 weeks and confirm insights actionable.

matt: Risk: cost regression when enabling adaptive sampling if error spikes. Mitigation: auto-fallback to head-sampling and throttle.

emma: Decision: ship per-route cost + error analytics for GA, trace hook basic sampling for GA, heatmap post-GA. Action items: jin scope & ETA, matt infra plan, aparna customer commit. Can we get updates by EOD tomorrow?

jin: I'll post ETA tomorrow noon PST. Starting PR for schema.

matt: I'll draft infra playbook and canary steps by EOD.

aparna: I'll reach out to AcmeHealth + PlateDrop to confirm pilots, cc'ing sana. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: Note: Next deploy window 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC; coordinate canary schedule.

emma: Thanks team. We'll lock this in if no objections by EOD. :+1:
